scenarios.name: Plan, build, and verify a bounded change
setup: Prepare a disposable repository containing one bounded change request.
Install the Varde skills and workflow CLI under evaluation.
workflow_actions: Create and finalize a plan with acceptance criteria.
Decompose the plan and execute every ready task sequentially.
Review the aggregate changes and verify every acceptance criterion.
observable_assertions: The finalized plan records explicit scope and acceptance criteria.
Every task reaches done with verification evidence.
The completed plan records verified acceptance criteria.

token_capture.method: Record harness usage after planning, each task, and final verification.

scenarios.name: Review, fix, and verify a seeded defect
setup: Prepare a disposable repository containing one observable seeded defect.
Capture the expected defect and regression check independently.
workflow_actions: Run a report-only review against the seeded change.
Apply the accepted finding through the review fix workflow.
observable_assertions: The review reports the seeded defect with concrete evidence.
The fix changes only files required by the finding.
The independent regression check passes afterward.

token_capture.method: Record harness usage for review, fix, and verification phases.

scenarios.name: Record and recall durable project knowledge
setup: Prepare a disposable repository with one documented project decision.
Remove that decision from the active conversation context.
workflow_actions: Record the decision through the knowledge workflow.
Ask the agent to retrieve and apply the decision.
observable_assertions: The knowledge note preserves the decision and its rationale.
The fresh context locates the correct knowledge note.
The resulting recommendation follows the recorded decision.

token_capture.method: Record harness usage for recording and fresh-context recall.
